content:
Sustainable Fiber Innovations and Their Practical Benefits # Nature to Nature: A Closed-Loop Approach # At AceGreen, we are dedicated to a holistic, environmentally responsible process that spans from raw material sourcing to finished products. Our closed-loop system ensures that every stage is designed with sustainability in mind:
Material: We use only Forestry Stewardship Council (FSC) certified sources, ensuring responsible forestry practices. Manufacturing: Our production adheres to the Man-Made Cellulose Fibers (MMCF) test standard of ZDHC (Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals), minimizing environmental impact. Product: Our fibers pass OEKO-TEX certification and undergo Beta and PIDC testing to confirm their bio-based and biodegradable nature. Nature to Nature Closed Loop Process Vegan Silk: Fine, Breathable Comfort # GreenCell® fibers, with a denier count of just 1.2~2 dpf, create fabrics that closely mimic the luxurious feel of silk. The result is a breathable, comfortable textile that offers a refined touch and natural elegance.
Vegan Silk with GreenCell® Moisture Wicking and Cooling: Naturally Dry and Breathable # Our fibers retain the natural moisture-regulating properties of wood. The fine, porous structure absorbs 7-15 times its weight in water, while advanced raw materials, solvents, and weaving techniques ensure that GreenCell® fibers keep the surface dry and provide a natural cooling effect. This balance of moisture retention and surface dryness enhances comfort in every application.
Moisture Wicking and Cooling Natural Deodorizing and Anti-static Properties # GreenCell® fabrics feature a smooth surface, thanks to the circular cross-section of each fiber. This design reduces bacterial growth and prevents odors from being trapped, keeping fabrics fresher for longer. The impressive humidistat properties (porosity of 11-13%) help retain moisture and prevent particulate matter from adhering, effectively eliminating static buildup. The result is a fabric that keeps skin dry, cool, hydrated, and healthy.

content:
Milestones in Sustainable Fiber Innovation # AceGreen Eco-Material Technology Co., Ltd. has a rich history rooted in the pursuit of sustainable and innovative fiber solutions. Our journey reflects a commitment to research, development, and the advancement of eco-friendly materials for a better future.
Key Historical Achievements # 1994
AceGreen’s parent company, Acelon, initiated research and development in Lyocell, setting the foundation for future advancements in cellulose-based fibers.
1996
Secured a patent for a “cellulose solution suitable for high speed spinning method,” marking a significant step in fiber production technology.
2001
Awarded a patent for a method to “reduce the degree of polymerization of the cellulose mucus color and recession,” further enhancing the quality and stability of cellulose fibers.
2004
Recognized by the Ministry of Economic Affairs with grants under the Industrial Technology Development Program for the long-term research and development of Lyocell spun cellulose filaments.
2006
Received additional grants from the Ministry of Economic Affairs for the development of chitosan healthcare cellulose fiber technology, expanding the functional applications of cellulose fibers.
2008
Supported by the Ministry of Economic Affairs for the development of wet meltblown nonwoven cellulose-cum-systems technology, broadening the scope of nonwoven material innovation.
2011
Established AceGreen as a subsidiary in Ershui Township, Changhua County, focusing on the production of cellulose fiber filament products.
The “Wet-spray cellulose non-woven-cum-melting system technology development plan” was honored with the 2011 Excellence in Industrial Upgrading Award from the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
2012
“Cellulose products of green filaments” received the 2012 Products/Systems Innovation Award from the Ministry of Economic Affairs, recognizing our commitment to sustainable product development.
2013
A patent for the “Method of making natural cellulose fiber with increased anti-mold, anti-bacterial and deodorizing functions” was awarded the 2013 National Invention & Creation Award - Silver Award, highlighting our focus on functional and health-promoting fibers.
2015
Qualified for the International Trade Administration’s customized marketing counselling subsidy. We actively promoted environmentally friendly and functional fiber products at textile exhibitions and introduced our innovations at the Intertextile Shanghai Apparel Fabrics press conference.
2020
In response to the Covid-19 pandemic, AceGreen engaged in the production of surgical masks and melt-blown non-woven materials featuring Nano-zinc (anti-bacterial) and electrostatic electret properties, contributing to public health and safety.
We remain dedicated to delivering a diverse range of high-quality, sustainable products and fostering collaborative partnerships for a greener future.

These materials not only enhance product performance but also align with our commitment to environmental responsibility.
Main Applications # Melt-blown nonwoven products are widely utilized in several critical applications, including:
